opinions.text: May 31, 1904. Petition for a writ of certiorari to the United States' Circuit Court of Appeals for the Sixth Circuit denied. Mr. Drury W. •Cooper, Mr. F. H. Betts and Mr. Thomas B. Kerr for petitioner. Mr. John R. Bennett and Mr. Arthur Stein for respondent.
